[Act: limitation
 Chapter: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases
 Section: 133::
]


To the Supreme Court for special leave to appeal,—
(a)in a case involving death sentence;
Period of limitationSixty days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the judgment final order or sentence.
(b)in a case where leave to appeal was refused by the High Court;
Period of limitationSixty days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the order of refusal.
(c)in any other case.
Period of limitationNinety days.
Time from which period begins to runThe date of the judgment or order.
